translations.web: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
translations.bsb: His undersides are jagged potsherds, spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge.
translations.kjv: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
translations.asv: His underparts are like sharp potsherds: He spreadeth as it were a threshing-wain upon the mire.
